summary: Iteration 11 testing completed successfully. All P0+P1 features verified: notification system (bell, dropdown, unread count, mark read/all), dashboard overhaul, PDF export, create-task-from-risk, activity timeline with filters, and RBAC (viewer 403). Backend: 22/22 tests passed. Frontend: All features working.

backend: GET /api/notifications returns list of 5 seeded notifications
PUT /api/notifications/read-all marks all as read (unread_count becomes 0)
GET /api/analytics/dashboard returns all sections (risk_heatmap 5x5, recent_activity, upcoming_deadlines, overdue_tasks, risk_distribution)
GET /api/reports/executive-pdf returns valid PDF with correct headers
GET /api/risks returns risks with open status
POST /api/tasks creates task from risk context
GET /api/activity returns activity log with various action types
All regression endpoints working (policies, frameworks, tasks, vendors, audits, evidence, mappings)
frontend: Dashboard loads with all sections: compliance score hero (81%, Grade B), 6 stat cards, framework chart, risk heatmap, overdue tasks, upcoming deadlines, recent activity, risk distribution, quick actions, PDF export button
Notification dropdown opens with 5 seeded notifications
Notification items show title, message, and timestamp
Mark all read button visible when unread notifications exist
Create Remediation Task button visible on 5 open risks
Create Remediation Task button NOT shown on mitigated/accepted risks
Clicking Create Remediation Task creates task with success toast
Activity page shows timeline view with date grouping (TODAY section)
Activity page has 7 filter buttons (All + 6 action types)
Activity filter works - clicking 'Task Created' shows 3 filtered items
Demo Viewer banner shows 'read-only access' message
Demo Viewer gets 'Failed to create risk' error when trying to create risk (RBAC working)

seed_data_creation: Demo data auto-seeded: 6 policies, 710 mappings, 7 risks (5 open, 1 mitigated, 1 accepted), 2 audits, 6+ tasks, 4 vendors, 8+ activity log entries, 5 notifications (3 unread, 2 read)
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0+P1 MVP features fully implemented and tested. Notification triggers on risk creation and task assignment. All dashboard sections working: compliance score hero, 6 stat cards, framework compliance chart, 5x5 risk heatmap, overdue tasks, upcoming deadlines, recent activity, risk distribution pie, quick actions, PDF export.
